title: 53rd sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/53/2024).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominee for a member of the National Integrity Commission (Article 11 of the National Integrity Commission Act, Law No. 27/2015) is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominee for Ambassador of the Maldives to the Kingdom of Thailand (Constitution Article 115(d) and Article 14 of the Foreign Service Act, Law No. 20/2021) is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
From the Speaker's desk: appointment of the Secretary General, Counsel General and Sergeant-at-Arms of the Majlis under Rule 16 of the Standing Orders.
First reading of the Bill amending the Maldives Sports Act (Law No. 30/2015), submitted on behalf of the government by Dhidhdhoo MP Abdul Latheef Mohamed.
Independent Institutions Committee report on its review of the Bill amending the Anti-Corruption Commission Act (Law No. 13/2008).
Independent Institutions Committee report on its review of the Bill amending the Elections Commission Act (Law No. 8/2008).
Independent Institutions Committee report on the removal from office of Elections Commission Vice President Ali Nashath and members Mohamed Asif and Dr Mohamed Zahir.
Independent Institutions Committee report on the removal from office of Civil Service Commission President Mohamed Nasih.
Independent Institutions Committee report on the removal from office of Anti-Corruption Commission Vice President Abdussalam and member Thahir Mohamed.
Budget Committee report on its review of the proposed State Budget for 2025.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: A packed sitting sent two presidential nominations to committee, gave first reading to a Sports Act amendment, and took up committee reports on the ACC and Elections Commission laws, the removal of Elections, Civil Service and Anti-Corruption commission members, and the 2025 State Budget.
